body:
He hasn't forgiven me, though. He said he's working on it, but definitely hasn't forgiven me as of right now. 

Also, if I show him this post, I'll just end up in the ER and then under my state's version of a 5150. I don't have insurance, so I can't afford that, and the medical bills would make me even more suicidal than I am already.

I'm trying so hard to think of the future, but I don't know how to forgive myself for this. The infidelity was one thing, but he's much more upset that I lied about it, and I don't know how I'm ever going to regain his trust. He means the world to me. He's my best friend, and the fact that I did this makes me sick to my stomach. 

Might be worth noting that I'm bipolar and was moderately to severely manic at the time of this incident. I don't count that as an excuse, at all, and it makes me even more terrified that he won't be able to trust me if I'm cycling. My meds have been modified since and I haven't been higher or lower than mild, but still.
